dedupe_keys.name: dreal bourgogne franche comte flood hazard datasets

description: DREAL Bourgogne-Franche-Comté: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Bourgogne-Franche-Comté. Coverage: DREAL Bourgogne-Franche-Comté. The listing groups 12 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Assemblage régional des zones inondables par débordements de cours d’e; Périmètres des PAPI (Programmes d'Actions de Prévention des Inondation; Extrait des zones inondables dans le cadre du 7ème programme d’actions; Coût cumulé des sinistres inondation par commune sur la période 1995-2. Formats seen: SHP, ODS, PDF, CSV, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
